# Fixture provenance

Except where explicitly identified, fixtures are original synthetic text/data created
for this repository and dedicated to CC0. They are not scholarly papers, human
relevance labels, or evidence of research quality. The small PDF is generated from
the same original text by `tests/make_pdf.py` (no third-party copyrighted paper).
Network 429/timeout responses and model judgments are injected test doubles.

Synthetic DOI strings exercise normalization and are not bibliographic claims.
The fulltext demo uses the original CC0 PDF and is explicitly synthetic. A suggested
future real-run example is *Attention Is All You Need*, arXiv:1706.03762; no public
paper PDF, experimental findings, or paid integration results are bundled.
